questions.question: Which command performs passive subdomain enumeration with Amass?
options: amass enum -passive -d example.com
amass brute -d example.com
amass scan --all example.com
amass enum -active -ip example.com
questions.explanation: `amass enum -passive -d example.com` queries third-party data sources without sending traffic to the target — the safest way to start discovery.

questions.question: After discovering subdomains, what does httpx do in the workflow?
options: Brute-forces login pages
Probes which discovered hosts are serving live web services
Downloads the full website content for offline analysis
Registers the subdomains to your account
questions.explanation: httpx takes a list of hosts and probes them to identify which ones respond with live web services, narrowing your list to assets that are actually reachable.

questions.question: What is the purpose of taking screenshots with a tool like gowitness?
options: To exploit vulnerabilities in the web server
To create visual evidence for reconnaissance, triage, and change detection
To bypass authentication on login pages
To measure page load performance
questions.explanation: Screenshots let you visually triage many services quickly (login portals, default pages, dashboards) and support diffing over time to detect unauthorized changes.

questions.question: Which target is appropriate for your first ASM scan?
options: Your favorite news website
A competitor's infrastructure
A domain you own or are explicitly authorized to test
A randomly selected IP range
questions.explanation: Only scan assets you own or have explicit permission to test. Even passive techniques should be practiced against your own or designated practice targets.

questions.question: What is the correct order of the first-scan workflow?
options: Screenshot services, then enumerate subdomains, then probe for live hosts
Probe for live hosts, then screenshot, then enumerate subdomains
Enumerate subdomains, then probe for live web services, then screenshot and analyze
Analyze results, then enumerate subdomains, then probe hosts
questions.explanation: The pipeline flows from broad to specific: discover subdomains (amass), find which are live web services (httpx), capture screenshots (gowitness), then analyze and document results.
